entry.title: Lessons from building an automated research scaffold
entry.content: TL;DR. We built a scaffold to speed up our own research and gather data on automated alignment research (AAR). entry.title: How to change your identity. A guide to the highest leverage behavior change technique.
entry.content: According to Atomic Habits, changing your identity is the highest leverage way to improve your habits, but nobody tells you how to do it.
